"""Phase 2 / Area 2.A — Workspace overlay edge cases (detection-only).

Each test drives the real ``orchestrator_harness.workspace_overlay`` seams
(``prepare_worktree`` / ``restore_worktree`` / ``verify_overlay_receipt`` /
``_read_declaration`` / ``_encode_bytes`` / ``_decode_bytes``) over fabricated
on-disk cache/worktree/receipt fixtures under ``tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()``.
No provider subprocess is launched and no harness source module is modified.

I4 carries a known PLAN-VS-REALITY divergence (recorded as FINDING F2A-I4-1):
the plan's I4 says "corrupt one materialized byte and re-verify via
``verify_overlay_receipt`` -> verification fails"; the real
``verify_overlay_receipt`` is a structural/identity prelaunch check (REQ-O41)
that never reads materialized worktree bytes.  Byte-integrity is enforced at
``restore_worktree`` (byte-for-byte comparison with the receipt's
``post_prepare_bytes``).  Both actual behaviors are pinned green here.

Feature IDs under test:

- I4 / A9  independent receipt verification (``verify_overlay_receipt``).
- I5  append-only plan + collision detection (``_build_plan`` /
       ``_validate_append_targets``).
- I7  reparse-point / regular-directory-only enforcement (``_is_reparse`` /
       ``_regular_directory`` / ``_walk_contents``).
- I8  ``_rollback_applied`` on a mid-apply failure.
- I9  declaration-file read/validate (``_read_declaration``).
- I10 byte encode/decode helpers (``_encode_bytes`` / ``_decode_bytes``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest import mock

from orchestrator_harness.mutation import MutationConflict, MutationError
from orchestrator_harness.workspace_overlay import (
    DECLARATION_NAME,
    OVERLAY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA,
    SUPER_CACHE_CONTROL_SCHEMA,
    OverlayCollisionError,
    WorkspaceOverlayError,
    _decode_bytes,
    _encode_bytes,
    _read_declaration,
    prepare_worktree,
    restore_worktree,
    verify_overlay_receipt,
)

APPEND_PAYLOAD = b"appended-payload\n"
CREATED_PAYLOAD = b"created by overlay\n"


class WorkspaceOverlayEdgeCompatTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self) -> None:
        self.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root = Path(self.temporary.name)
        self.cache = self.root / "cache"
        self.cache.mkdir()
        self.target = self.root / "target"
        self.target.mkdir()
        self.receipt = self.root / "receipts" / "overlay-receipt.json"

    def tearDown(self) -> None:
        self.temporary.cleanup()

    def _write(self, root: Path, relative: str, data: bytes) -> None:
        path = root / relative
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(data)

    def _declaration(self, append_text: list[str]) -> bytes:
        return json.dumps(
            {"schema": SUPER_CACHE_CONTROL_SCHEMA, "append_text": append_text}
        ).encode("utf-8")

    def _snapshot(self, root: Path) -> dict[str, bytes | None]:
        """Full ``{relative_posix: bytes}`` map; ``None`` marks a directory."""
        entries: dict[str, bytes | None] = {}
        for path in sorted(root.rglob("*")):
            if path.is_dir():
                entries[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = None
            else:
                entries[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
        return entries

    def _make_junction(self, link: Path, target: Path) -> None:
        """Create a junction (Windows) or symlink (POSIX) or skip the test."""
        if os.name == "nt":
            completed = subprocess.run(
                ["cmd", "/c", "mklink", "/J", str(link), str(target)],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
                check=False,
            )
            ok = completed.returncode == 0 and link.exists()
        else:
            try:
                os.symlink(target, link)
                ok = link.exists()
            except OSError:
                ok = False
        if not ok:
            self.skipTest(
                "directory junctions/symlinks are unavailable in this environment"
            )

    # ---- I4 / A9: independent receipt verification ----

    def _prepare_append_cache(self) -> None:
        """Cache with one created file + one declared-append file; target holds
        the append preimage.  Runs a real ``prepare_worktree``."""
        self._write(self.cache, "created.txt", CREATED_PAYLOAD)
        self._write(self.cache, "notes.txt", APPEND_PAYLOAD)
        self._write(
            self.cache,
            DECLARATION_NAME,
            self._declaration(["notes.txt"]),
        )
        self._write(self.target, "notes.txt", b"original-notes\n")
        result = prepare_worktree(
            super_cache=self.cache,
            target_worktree=self.target,
            role="subagent",
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
        )
        self.assertTrue(result["complete"])

    def test_i4_verify_present_receipt_passes_without_restore(self) -> None:
        self._prepare_append_cache()
        self.assertEqual(CREATED_PAYLOAD, (self.target / "created.txt").read_bytes())
        verified = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertTrue(verified["present"])
        self.assertTrue(verified["verified"])
        self.assertEqual("subagent", verified["role"])
        self.assertIn("matches the identified subagent worktree", verified["reason"])
        # verify is independent of restore: nothing was restored or removed.
        self.assertTrue((self.target / "created.txt").is_file())
        self.assertEqual(
            b"original-notes\n" + APPEND_PAYLOAD,
            (self.target / "notes.txt").read_bytes(),
        )

    def test_i4_verify_catches_receipt_structural_and_identity_corruption(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        self._prepare_append_cache()

        other = self.root / "other"
        other.mkdir()
        wrong_target = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=other,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertTrue(wrong_target["present"])
        self.assertFalse(wrong_target["verified"])
        self.assertIn("does not match the launch worktree", wrong_target["reason"])

        wrong_role = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="orchestrator",
        )
        self.assertFalse(wrong_role["verified"])
        self.assertIn("role", wrong_role["reason"])

        raw = json.loads(self.receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        raw["role"] = "orchestrator"
        self.receipt.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
        role_tampered = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertFalse(role_tampered["verified"])
        self.assertIn("role", role_tampered["reason"])

        raw = json.loads(self.receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        raw["completed"] = False
        self.receipt.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
        not_completed = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertTrue(not_completed["present"])
        self.assertFalse(not_completed["verified"])
        self.assertIn("not completed", not_completed["reason"])

        raw = json.loads(self.receipt.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        raw["schema"] = "orchestrator-workspace-overlay-receipt/v9"
        self.receipt.write_text(json.dumps(raw), encoding="utf-8")
        wrong_schema = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertFalse(wrong_schema["verified"])
        self.assertIn("schema", wrong_schema["reason"])

        self.receipt.write_text("{broken", encoding="utf-8")
        malformed = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertTrue(malformed["present"])
        self.assertFalse(malformed["verified"])
        self.assertIn("receipt", malformed["reason"])

    def test_i4_byte_corruption_blocks_restore_not_verify(self) -> None:
        # F2A-I4-1: verify_overlay_receipt is a structural/identity prelaunch
        # check (REQ-O41) and never reads materialized worktree bytes;
        # byte-integrity is enforced at restore_worktree.
        self._prepare_append_cache()
        created = self.target / "created.txt"
        created.write_bytes(CREATED_PAYLOAD + b"X")  # one corrupted byte
        verified = verify_overlay_receipt(
            receipt_path=self.receipt,
            expected_target_worktree_id=self.target,
            role="subagent",
        )
        self.assertTrue(verified["verified"])  # still verifies: no byte read
        restored = restore_worktree(receipt_path=self.receipt)
        self.assertEqual("BLOCKED", restored["outcome"])
        self.assertIn("later edit detected", restored["reason"])
        self.assertIn("created.txt", restored["preserved_paths"])
        self.assertEqual(CREATED_PAYLOAD + b"X", created.read_bytes())

    # ---- I5: append-only plan + collision detection ----

    def test_i5_undocumented_collision_rejected_with_no_partial_write(self) -> None:
        self._write(self.cache, "a.txt", b"would-be-created\n")
        self._write(self.cache, "z.txt", b"from cache\n")
        self._write(self.target, "z.txt", b"preexisting target bytes\n")
        before = self._snapshot(self.target)
        with self.assertRaises(OverlayCollisionError):
            prepare_worktree(
                super_cache=self.cache,
                target_worktree=self.target,
                role="subagent",
                receipt_path=self.receipt,
            )
        # The collision was preflighted before any mutation: nothing applied,
        # including the cache file that sorts before the colliding one.
        self.assertEqual(before, self._snapshot(self.target))
        self.assertFalse((self.target / "a.txt").exists())
        self.assertFalse(self.receipt.exists())
        self.assertFalse(self.receipt.parent.exists())
